title: Revoke OAuth token
description: Revoke a refresh token, on uninstall or disconnect. Replaces the v1 DELETE.
$sideEffectsComment: Revoking a token that is already revoked changes nothing.

auth.$comment: HubSpot's 2026-03 page names only 'the refresh token in a URL-encoded request body'. The client credentials are taken from its 2026-09 reference: INFERRED for 2026-03, not confirmed. The first live revoke settles it.

config.label: Token type
config.description: Which kind of token `token` is. Optional.

outputShape.description: HubSpot's answer, as it arrived; null when it answers with an empty body.
